title: Nova Scotia court approves C$470m wage-freeze deal, up to C$5,000 per worker

The settlement follows a ruling that declared a 2015 law restricting wage increases and long-service benefits unconstitutional. Around 81,000 workers may qualify for wage-related damages, while payments must be completed by December 31, 2027.

Buyers discovered a looming nine-storey structure that would block their ocean views just after signing the contract. The ruling emphasized that agents misrepresented crucial information. Following the legal wrangling, the property eventually sold for just $5.1 million, underscoring the critical need for transparency in real estate dealings.

title: Hawaii woman's kindness reunites Chicago family with long-lost photo albums

Anna Richardson and her mother traveled across the country to retrieve their family memories. Upon meeting Lopez, they reflected on the history preserved in the photographs. This encounter highlights the importance of family history and acts of kindness.

description: A historic building at 802 High Street, Thornbury, is set to hit the market soon. Initially a motor garage, the property has served various purposes over the years, including an independent cinema. Its renovation in 2018 transformed it into a popular destination combining film screenings with social gatherings. The auction scheduled for December 3 includes the cinema and a residential unit above.

She had entrusted three sarees to a Tumbledry outlet for dry cleaning, paying a fee of Rs 564. After discovering the damage, she sought help but received unsatisfactory responses. Eventually, she took legal action against the brand and its franchisee for their negligence.

This order has sparked concerns over federal principles, judiciary roles, and temple administration. Previous Supreme Court directives on security forces for the event's smooth execution have raised questions about the implications for religious harmony among communities.

title: Son, wife allowed to stay 'out of love' must vacate mother's room: Delhi court
description: A Delhi court has upheld an order directing a man and his wife to vacate a room in his 65-year-old widowed mother's house, where she let them stay temporarily out of love and affection. District judge Sumit Dalal held they are licensees with no legal right, rejected their adverse possession plea and gave them 30 days to vacate.

title: 22 years after gifting property, K'taka woman fails to reclaim it from daughter-in-law
description: The Karnataka High Court recently overturned a tribunal's decision to cancel a 2000 property gift deed. The elderly woman claimed that her daughter-in-law obtained the deed through fraud, but the court found otherwise. The gift deed was registered and the transfer was legally completed prior to the relevant law's enactment. The sister-in-law will continue payments of Rs 4,000 each month to her mother-in-law as directed by the court.

title: Cold coffee, cigarettes and food orders: 'Cyber trap' that didn't look like one
description: Delhi Police dismantled a cyber fraud syndicate operating from Noida, rescuing 164 foreign nationals exploited in fraudulent activities. The syndicate, led by a Malaysian man, trained recruits in other countries before bringing them to India. Allegations included working under duress and facing financial pressure, though no complaints of torture were reported. The authorities seized numerous electronic devices and passports during the operation.

title: Akash Deep joins Zaheer Khan, Ishant Sharma in elite list
description: Akash Deep returned figures of 5/95 as India bowled out New Zealand for 356 on Day 2 of the second Test at Hagley Oval on Saturday. He was instrumental in breaking the hosts' resistance and dismissing their lower-order batters.

OpenAI vs Apple: ChatGPT maker countersues iPhone maker for stealing trade secrets
description: OpenAI has countersued Apple, alleging that the tech giant stole trade secrets and restricted supplier access. This legal conflict stems from claims of employee poaching by Apple, which OpenAI vehemently denies. Apple initially filed a lawsuit against OpenAI and former employees regarding misappropriation of trade secrets. The legal battle coincides with growing competition over artificial intelligence products and proprietary technology.

title: Yashasvi Jaiswal overtakes Virat Kohli for unwanted WTC record
description: Yashasvi Jaiswal faced a disappointing dismissal, falling for a six-ball duck against New Zealand in Christchurch. This dismissal made him the Indian batter with the most ducks in World Test Championship history. Previously, Jaiswal had scored an impressive 85 runs in the opening Test against New Zealand in Wellington. India had bowled out New Zealand for 356 runs in their first innings, with Akash Deep taking five wickets.

title: Deepam lighting at Deepathoon today: CRPF deployed in Thiruparankundram after SC order
description: In Thiruparankundram, CRPF personnel are on duty to ensure the ceremonial Karthigai Deepam lamp is lit, following a Supreme Court order mandating the lamp's illumination at the Deepathoon stone pillar. This comes after previous issues with compliance. Under the court's directives, devotees can attend the ceremony, while the Tamil Nadu government has filed a review petition challenging the interim order.

This marked only the third time Bumrah bowled without taking a wicket in a Test innings. Akash Deep stood out for India, taking five wickets while New Zealand was bowled out for 356 runs. Tom Blundell scored 89 runs and contributed significantly to New Zealand's total.

No injuries were reported as the Federal Aviation Administration began investigating the event. Both aircraft returned to their gates for inspection, after which American Airlines arranged alternative travel for passengers.

Rohit replaces Hardik Pandya after three seasons as captain, leading to speculation about the team's performance. The Mumbai franchise has historically succeeded under Rohit's leadership, winning five IPL titles. Suryakumar, retained by the team, previously played under both Rohit and Hardik.

title: WWE announces death of star Bronson Reed at 38
description: WWE has announced the death of wrestler Bronson Reed, also known as Jermaine Haley, at age 38. He died due to medical complications, as confirmed by WWE’s official statement on social media. Reed was a beloved performer as well as a devoted family man, which has left the wrestling community in shock. His last performance was at Crown Jewel where he sustained serious injuries during a match.

title: At least eight found dead on migrant boat off Spain’s Canary Islands

title: How BJP, DMK's year-long negotiations paved way for delimitation deal
description: After intense negotiations, DMK decides to support the BJP-led Union government's delimitation bill, a notable change from their previous stance. This strategic move comes after discussions concerning proportional seat adjustments and census freezes. DMK aims to balance its political aspirations while safeguarding Tamil Nadu's representation in the Lok Sabha, underscoring that party interests remain a top priority amid earlier fears of losing seats.

title: CJI had sought probe against HC judge. He is Jharkhand acting CJ now
description: CJI Surya Kant asked M S Sonak to investigate multiple complaints regarding Justice Sujit Narayan Prasad's integrity. Many of these complaints were supported by documentary evidence, which adds credibility to the claims. Complaints against Justice Prasad also reached Chief Minister Hemant Soren, who urged CJI Kant to address these concerns. Justice Prasad has held his position since 2014 but could face scrutiny due to the complaints received.

title: Bisleri in fresh trouble: After Goa, FSSAI finds bacteria in West Bengal water sample
description: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India has initiated prosecution against Bisleri International over unsafe drinking water samples. Recent tests revealed coliform bacteria in samples from its West Bengal and Goa plants. FSSAI has restricted the sale of specific batches following these findings and intensified surveillance on packaged drinking water quality. The regulator aims to ensure compliance with food safety norms across the country.

title: China helping Pak boost space capability, we need to enhance our capabilities: CDS
description: General N S Raja Subramani observed that Pakistan's advancements in space technology are being bolstered by collaboration with China and Turkey. He underscored the critical role of India's Space-Based Surveillance Phase-III initiative in strengthening national security. The General also addressed the integration of tech in military strategies, advocating for reforms in equipment procurement.

title: 'Repeated quarrels over another man': What led to Bengaluru lodge murder
description: A 23-year-old man named Gokul Krishna was arrested for allegedly stabbing his girlfriend Ganga. The incident occurred at a lodge in Cottonpet during an argument over suspicions of infidelity. Ganga, a 22-year-old nursing graduate, suffered fatal injuries and died at the hospital. Investigation revealed that Krishna planned the attack and brought a knife to the lodge. Authorities have opened a murder case following the incident.

title: Mumbai man rapes 60-year-old woman in Ghatkopar railway station washroom
description: In a shocking incident at Ghatkopar railway station, a 60-year-old woman was attacked in a washroom late Thursday night while with her daughter. The suspect, recorded by CCTV, entered the facility shortly before midnight. After reporting the assault, the woman helped authorities quickly track down the attacker, leading to the arrest of a 25-year-old man, Taslim Noor Mohammad.

title: ‘No entry for pastors’: 5 tribal villages in Chhattisgarh put up boards
description: Five tribal villages in Jashpur district, Chhattisgarh, have made headlines by installing boards prohibiting Christian pastors and nuns from entering their territories, a decision endorsed by local leaders to preserve indigenous culture. This controversial action has raised significant concerns regarding religious freedom and constitutional rights, prompting a Christian tribal group to challenge the legality of the boards, intensifying the discourse on tribal autonomy and religious practices in the region.

title: Texas grants SpaceX permit as data center approvals start before Hinojosa’s term
description: SpaceX has obtained an air pollution permit for a natural gas power plant in Boca Chica, Texas. The plant is part of a larger supercomputing complex planned east of Brownsville. Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa has promised to pause new data center developments and end tax breaks for the industry. Local authorities are set to discuss a property tax break for the project on December 9.

title: Oregon family restores abandoned mobile home for mother and twin daughters
description: An Oregon family took on the challenge of revamping a deserted mobile home into a cozy space for their relatives. Lyman Branson II and his family poured months of effort into fixing the property for Betty Branson and her daughters. Despite budget hurdles, they created a safe haven. Just in time for Thanksgiving, they received the occupancy certificate, allowing them to celebrate their first holiday together in their new home.
